replacements.instruction: Remove the duplicated model-tier selection rationale from Appendix Runtime Configuration once the concise rationale and citations are restored in the main Implementation section.
replacements.before:
We hold the generator, output-token budget, network and retrieval policy, approval policy, task input, and final-output requirements fixed so that the compared conditions differ in how they organize the writing process rather than in model access or external information.
We choose Luna for high-volume long-form generation because OpenAI positions it for fast, cost-sensitive workloads, and Sol as the primary evaluator because it is the higher-capability tier for complex professional work.
Assigning the higher-capability tier to evaluation keeps generation scalable; the shared model family motivates the cross-family check~\citep{openai2026luna,openai2026sol,openai2026gpt56}.
Each prompt--condition pair is generated in three runs.
replacements.after:
